description: This file defines the EventHubAdapterFactory class, which implements multiple interfaces to create and manage Event Hub stream adapters within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for initializing the client, creating adapters, managing receivers, and handling message batching for Event Hubs.

classes.name: EventHubAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing Event Hub stream adapters in Orleans, supporting initialization, message batching, receiver creation, and client management.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the adapter factory, including setting up receivers, client, and default factories.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate an EventHubAdapterFactory with dependencies from IServiceProvider.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and initializes the stream adapter, including fetching partition IDs and setting up the queue mapper.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache interface for the adapter.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper; must be called after CreateAdapter.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a failure handler for a specific queue.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Sends a batch of messages to Event Hub for a specific stream.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver for a specific queue.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a cache for a specific queue.

methods.name: InitEventHubClient
methods.description: Initializes the Event Hub producer client.

methods.name: CreateCacheFactory
methods.description: Creates a cache factory for Event Hub message caching.

methods.name: GetPartitionIdsAsync
methods.description: Fetches partition IDs from Event Hub asynchronously.
